import { makeSortableList, useDnD, useDnDMonitor } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import CardPanel from './CardPanel.vue';

import Trash from './Trash.vue';

const board = inject(BOARD)!;
const { selection, status } = useDnD();

const lanes = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('lanes');
// The columns are a sortable list too, side by side: drag a column by its header. A ref,
// unlike the cards: the library writes the new order of the columns itself.
const { items } = makeSortableList(lanes, {
  id: 'columns',
  items: board.columns,
  strategy: 'horizontal',
  axis: 'x',
});

// Cards just dropped into Done play their check once they have landed.
useDnDMonitor({
  onDragSettle: (event) => {
    const target = event.over ? board.column(event.over.id) : undefined;
    if ('dropped' in event && target?.confirm && event.source?.list !== target.id) board.complete(event.accepted);
  },
});

// The filters hide cards: the selection keeps only the cards still shown.
watch([board.query, board.people], () => {
  selection.set([...selection.ids].filter((id) => board.cards.value.some((card) => card.id === id && board.matches(card))));
});

// Closed, the panel gives the focus back to its card.
const close = async () => {
  const id = board.opened.value;
  board.opened.value = null;
  await nextTick();
  lanes.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-card="${id}"]`)?.focus();
};

// Escape closes the panel, then clears the selection. A drag takes its Escape first (it
// cancels the drag), and a key the demo uses doesn't also leave the expanded frame.
const onEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.defaultPrevented || status.value !== 'idle') return;
  if (board.opened.value) void close();
  else if (selection.ids.size) selection.clear();
  else return;
  event.preventDefault();
};

const done = computed(() => board.columns.value.find((column) => column.confirm)?.cards.length ?? 0);
const total = computed(() => board.cards.value.length);
</script>

import { computed, inject } from 'vue';
import { DragPreview, type DnDStatus, type DragItem, type Over } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Icon from './Icon.vue';
import StatusIcon from './StatusIcon.vue';
import { BOARD } from './store';

// The overlay's props this one reads (see `OverlayProps`).
const props = defineProps<{ items: DragItem[]; over: Over | null; accepted: boolean; status: DnDStatus }>();
const board = inject(BOARD)!;

// A preview is as large as its card was; here each one fills the box instead.
const FILL = { width: '100%', height: '100%' };
// Where the cards under the grabbed one lie: turned by their wrappers' `transform`, which
// the landing undoes as each one flies to its own slot.
const PILE = ['translate(7px, 6px) rotate(3deg)', 'translate(-6px, 10px) rotate(-3.5deg)'];

/** The cards under the grabbed one, the deepest first. */
const pile = computed(() =>
  props.items
    .slice(1, 3)
    .map((item, index) => ({ item, place: PILE[index] }))
    .reverse(),
);

/** What letting go here would do, said under the cards while they are dragged. */
const hint = computed(() => {
  if (props.status !== 'dragging' || !props.over) return null;
  const many = props.items.length > 1 ? ` ${props.items.length} cards` : '';
  if (props.over.id === 'trash') return { tone: 'danger', icon: 'trash', text: `Delete${many}` };
  const column = board.column(props.over.id);
  if (!column) return null;
  if (!props.accepted) return { tone: 'danger', icon: 'limit', text: `${column.title} is full · ${column.limit} max` };
  // The board changes on drop: while dragging, the grabbed card is still in its column.
  if (board.find(props.items[0]!.id)?.column.id === column.id) return null;
  if (column.confirm) return { tone: 'done', column, text: `Complete${many}` };
  return { tone: '', column, text: `Move${many} to ${column.title}` };
});

import Card from './Card.vue';
import CardOverlay from './CardOverlay.vue';
import Composer from './Composer.vue';
import StatusIcon from './StatusIcon.vue';
import { BOARD, type Column } from './store';

const props = defineProps<{ column: Column }>();
const board = inject(BOARD)!;
const { active } = useDnD();

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
const grip = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('grip');
const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');

// The column is an item of the board's list, dragged by its header...
makeSortableItem(el, { item: () => props.column, handle: grip, type: 'column' });

// ...and holds a list of cards, in one group with the other columns.
const { items, isOver, isAccepting } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.column.id,
  // A getter: the list shows the cards the filters let through, and never writes them.
  // `onDrop` hands each drop to the board, which keeps the hidden cards in their places.
  items: () => props.column.cards.filter(board.matches),
  // `put` sees every card of a multi-drag at once: all of them fit under the limit, or none.
  group: { name: 'cards', put: ({ keys }) => board.fits(props.column, keys) },
  overlay: CardOverlay,
  // Cards that come and go without a drag (filters, Add card, Undo) slide and fade too.
  animateChanges: true,
  // Cards coming into Done wait for an answer: 'accept', 'reject', or 'continue' to keep dragging.
  onBeforeDrop: (event) => (props.column.confirm && !event.sameList ? board.ask(event.items) : 'accept'),
  onDrop: (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    board.apply(event);
  },
});

const full = computed(() => !!props.column.limit && props.column.cards.length >= props.column.limit);
/** Cards a drag over the column would bring in: the WIP meter lights them up. */
const incoming = computed(() => {
  if (!isOver.value || !isAccepting.value) return 0;
  return active.value?.ids.filter((id) => board.find(id)?.column.id !== props.column.id).length ?? 0;
});

// A card just added shows at the end of the list.
const reveal = async () => {
  await nextTick();
  list.value?.scrollTo({ top: list.value.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' });
};
</script>

import Icon from './Icon.vue';
import { BOARD, type Column } from './store';

// Quick add at the bottom of a column: type a title, Enter adds it, Escape closes.
const props = defineProps<{ column: Column; full: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ added: [] }>();
const board = inject(BOARD)!;

const writing = ref(false);
const title = ref('');
const field = useTemplateRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>('field');
const button = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('button');

const open = async () => {

  await nextTick();
  field.value?.focus();
};
const close = async () => {
  writing.value = false;
  title.value = '';
  await nextTick();
  button.value?.focus();
};

const submit = () => {
  const text = title.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  board.add(props.column, text);
  title.value = '';
  emit('added');
  if (props.column.limit && props.column.cards.length >= props.column.limit) void close();
};
</script>

/**

 * cards; the lists only read them, filtered, and each drop is applied here (`apply`).
 */
export function createBoard() {
  const columns = ref(sample());
  let lastId = 47;

  const cards = computed(() => columns.value.flatMap((column) => column.cards));
  const find = (id: Key) => {
    for (const column of columns.value) {
      const index = column.cards.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === id);
      if (index >= 0) return { column, index, card: column.cards[index]! };
    }
    return null;
  };
  const column = (id: Key) => columns.value.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
  /** The card open in the side panel. */
  const opened = ref<string | null>(null);
  const openedCard = computed(() => (opened.value ? find(opened.value)?.card : undefined));
  /** Room left in a column for these cards: those already in it don't count twice. */
  const fits = (target: Column, ids: Key[]) =>
    !target.limit || target.cards.filter((entry) => !ids.includes(entry.id)).length + ids.length <= target.limit;

  // ─── Filters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const query = ref('');
  /** People whose cards are shown; none picked shows everyone's. */
  const people = ref<string[]>([]);
  const filtering = computed(() => !!query.value.trim() || people.value.length > 0);

  const matches = (entry: Card) => {
    const words = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const text = [entry.id, entry.title, ...entry.labels.map((id) => label(id).name), ...entry.people.map((id) => person(id).name)]
      .join(' ')
      .toLowerCase();
    return (!words || text.includes(words)) && (!people.value.length || entry.people.some((id) => people.value.includes(id)));
  };
  const clearFilters = () => {
    query.value = '';
    people.value = [];
  };

  /**
   * A column's cards once a drop has changed the ones shown: those fill the places the
   * shown cards had, in their new order, and the filtered-out cards stay where they were.
   */
  const merge = (all: Card[], shown: Card[]) => {
    const queue = [...shown];
    const merged: Card[] = [];
    for (const entry of all) {
      if (!matches(entry)) merged.push(entry);
      else if (queue.length) merged.push(queue.shift()!);
    }
    // Cards that came in from another column and found no place left: at the end.
    return [...merged, ...queue];
  };

  /** Applies a drop: `result` holds the new (filtered) cards of every column it changed. */
  const apply = (event: SortableDropEvent<Card>) => {
    for (const [id, shown] of event.result) {
      const target = column(id);
      if (target) target.cards = merge(target.cards, shown);
    }
  };

  // ─── Notices and undo ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const notice = shallowRef<{ text: string; undo?: () => void } | null>(null);
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const notify = (text: string, undo?: () => void) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    notice.value = { text, undo };
    timer = setTimeout(() => (notice.value = null), 6000);
  };
  const dismiss = () => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    notice.value = null;
  };

  /** Deletes cards, keeping where each one was: Undo puts them back there. */
  const remove = (ids: Key[]) => {
    const removed = ids.flatMap((id) => {
      const place = find(id);
      return place ? [{ columnId: place.column.id, index: place.index, card: place.card }] : [];
    });
    if (!removed.length) return;
    for (const entry of columns.value) entry.cards = entry.cards.filter((each) => !ids.includes(each.id));
    if (opened.value && ids.includes(opened.value)) opened.value = null;
    const what = removed.length > 1 ? `${removed.length} cards` : removed[0]!.card.id;
    notify(`Deleted ${what}`, () => {
      // The first places first: each one is counted with the cards already back.
      for (const { columnId, index, card: back } of [...removed].sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index)) {
        column(columnId)?.cards.splice(index, 0, back);
      }
      notify(`Restored ${what}`);
    });
  };

  const add = (target: Column, title: string) => {
    const created = card(++lastId, title);
    target.cards.push(created);
    // A new card shows up even when the filters would hide it.
    if (!matches(created)) clearFilters();
    return created;
  };

  // ─── The Done question and the check ─────────────────────────────────────────

  /** The open question about cards moving into Done, and how to answer the waiting drop. */
  const question = shallowRef<{ cards: Card[]; resolve: (answer: Answer) => void } | null>(null);
  const ask = (moving: Card[]) => new Promise<Answer>((resolve) => (question.value = { cards: moving, resolve }));
  const answer = (value: Answer) => {
    question.value?.resolve(value);
    question.value = null;
  };

  /** Cards that have just landed in Done: they play their check for a moment. */
  const completed = ref(new Set<Key>());
  const complete = (ids: Key[]) => {
    completed.value = new Set(ids);
    setTimeout(() => (completed.value = new Set()), 1400);
  };

  return {
    columns,
    cards,
    find,
    column,
    fits,
    query,
    people,
    filtering,
    matches,
    clearFilters,
    apply,
    notice,
    notify,
    dismiss,
    remove,
    add,
    opened,
    openedCard,
    question,
    ask,
    answer,
    completed,
    complete,
  };
}

export type Board = ReturnType<typeof createBoard>;
export const BOARD: InjectionKey<Board> = Symbol('board');

/**
 * Moves cards to a column without a drag of yours: the Status buttons of the panel and
 * the selection bar. `moveItem` plays a real keyboard drag of the first card (a selected
 * one brings the selection), so it is announced and animated, and the column's limit and
 * the Done question apply as they do to your drags. Call it in a component's setup.
 */
export function useMove() {
  const board = inject(BOARD)!;
  const { moveItem } = useDnDActions();
  return (ids: Key[], target: Column) => {
    if (!board.fits(target, ids)) return board.notify(`${target.title} is full: ${target.limit} cards at most`);
    void moveItem(ids[0]!, { list: target.id });
  };
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { inject, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, useDnD, useDnDMonitor } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { BOARD } from './store';

const board = inject(BOARD)!;
const { selection } = useDnD();

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// A plain drop target that takes cards only (their `type`), not columns. The board owns
// the cards, so the trash deletes them there, as the Delete buttons do: Undo brings them
// back. With no slot left to land on, the cards go into the trash one after another.
const { isOver, isAccepting } = makeDroppable(el, {
  id: 'trash',
  accept: 'card',
  onDrop: (event) => {
    board.remove(event.active.ids);
    selection.delete(...event.active.ids);
  },
});

// The lid shuts once the last card is in: a new count plays the gulp again.
const gulps = ref(0);
useDnDMonitor({
  onDragSettle: (event) => {
    if ('dropped' in event && event.over?.id === 'trash') gulps.value++;
  },
});
</script>

<template>

    </svg>
    <span>{{ isOver && isAccepting ? 'Release to delete' : isAccepting ? 'Drop to delete' : 'Trash' }}</span>

</template>
